quiz.subject: Anglais

questions.question: What is the English word for 'rouge'?
'The number 5 is greater than the number 3' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English word for 'nombres'?
'The number 10 is less than the number 20' is a true statement.
What is the English word for 'lundi'?
'The week has seven days' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a common English word for 'couleurs'?
'The color blue is often associated with calmness and tranquility' is a true statement.
